posts.title: Almanac Health
posts.description: I‘m excited to announce that I recently joined the team pioneering safe, research-backed AI for clinicians at Almanac Health as a Senior Software Engineer! Since My Last Post… About 300k people saw my posts across various platforms. From the bottom of my heart thank you to those who reached out, shared an opportunity, offered advice, or wished me well. If I haven‘t replied, please reach out again.

posts.title: A Career Update
posts.description: I was recently informed that I am being laid oﬀ from my position at Apple. posts.title: First!
posts.description: This is a test of the outdoor warning system… If you’ve ever lived in San Francisco before 2020 you might remember this ominous test warning announcement that occurred every Tuesday at high-noon. Much like that benign warning that became a part of San Franciscan life, this blog is here to become a part of mine: where I can share thoughts, ideas, recipes, and whatever else that comes to mind.
